comment: NPC difficulty tuning. This file hot-reloads while the game runs: edit it, save, and changes apply immediately (no restart). The keys with "comment_" prefixes are documentation only and are ignored by the game. See src/npc/npc-difficulty-config.cpp.
comment_maxAngularErrorDegrees: Aim miss-cone in degrees. Lower = more accurate = deadlier. 2 = dangerous (most shots hit), 5 = stormtrooper-ish (frequent misses), 0 = perfect aim (same as forceHit).
comment_difficultyErrorScale: 0 to 1. How much an NPC's difficulty (1-10) shrinks the miss-cone. 0 = all NPCs equally accurate. 1 = max-difficulty NPCs get the full reduction from maxAngularErrorDegrees.
comment_damageMultiplier: Multiplies weapon damage when an NPC hits the player. Revolver base is 12, so x3 = 36 per body shot; a 100 HP player dies in ~3 hits. Set 1.0 for normal damage, higher for brutal NPCs.
comment_fireDelayMin: Fastest allowed seconds between NPC shots. Values below the weapon's own fire_delay are clamped to the weapon value. 0 = always use the weapon's own fire_delay.
comment_fireDelayMax: Slowest allowed seconds between NPC shots (the old built-in cap was 0.5). Lower = NPCs shoot more often.
comment_aggressionBonus: Added to NPC aggression, which pushes shot timing toward fireDelayMin (faster fire) and makes them more willing to attack. 0 = neutral, 1 = nearly always maximum fire rate.
comment_forceHit: Debug switch. true = zero aim error, every NPC shot lands on its target (overrides maxAngularErrorDegrees). Useful to verify damage/fire-rate without worrying about aim.
